Lab Summary Bixby is an intelligent personal assistant which is only available as a built-in application on Samsung flagship devices and wearables. jobs_results.description:
Our companyAt Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

What You’ll DoWe are building the next generation of AI-powered knowledge, reasoning, and autonomous agent platforms that operate at enterprise scale. We are seeking an exceptional Principal NLP Engineer to own and lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced natural language technologies powering semantic and context graphs, context analysis, intelligent search, retrieval, question answering, knowledge extraction, reasoning systems, AI agents, and enterprise copilots for Teradata Context Engine, our Autonomous Knowledge Platform. Context Engine is a platform that converts enterprise data estates into governed, agent-ready knowledge. Built for organizations where AI reliability and auditability are non-negotiable, Context Engine enables companies to deploy AI workflows on the data they already own — without rebuilding their infrastructure, without retraining their models, and without waiting for generic AI synthesis to learn the business terminology that took their analysts years to master.

This is a deeply hands-on technical leadership role for a recognized expert in Natural Language Processing who combines strong research foundations with proven experience shipping production systems that serve millions of users and process billions of documents. You will work at the intersection of large language models, information retrieval, knowledge graphs, semantic understanding, and agentic AI.

The ideal candidate has a track record of driving breakthrough NLP capabilities from research to production and possesses deep expertise across classical NLP, modern transformer architectures, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multimodal understanding, information extraction, and large-scale language model systems.

Drive innovation in enterprise language understanding, semantic search, retrieval systems, knowledge extraction, and AI reasoning.

jobs_results.description:
Our company is at the forefront of artificial intelligence, specializing in the development of cutting-edge natural language processing technologies. We are dedicated to advancing how machines understand and interact with human language, transforming communication and data analysis across various industries. We value innovation, precision, and a collaborative approach in our quest to develop intelligent NLP solutions.




We are looking for a skilled Natural Language Processing Engineer to join our team. This role involves developing and implementing NLP systems that can effectively interpret, analyze, and understand human language. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of NLP techniques and a passion for solving complex linguistic and computational challenges.



Key Responsibilities:





 Design and develop NLP systems and applications.
 Implement algorithms to process and analyze large amounts of natural language data.
 Develop systems for text representation, semantic extraction, data retrieval, and natural language understanding.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate NLP capabilities into products and services.
 Continuously update and maintain NLP models for accuracy and efficiency.
 Conduct research and stay updated on the latest advancements in NLP.
 Evaluate and refine NLP systems based on user feedback and performance metrics.
 Document NLP processes and algorithms for knowledge sharing.


Qualifications:



 Master's or Ph.D. in Computational Linguistics, Computer Science, AI, or related fields.
 Proven experience as an NLP Engineer or similar role.
 Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or similar languages.
 Experience with NLP tools and frameworks (e.g., NLTK, SpaCy, TensorFlow).
 Deep understanding of text representation techniques (e.g., n-grams, bag of words, sentiment analysis).
 Familiarity with machine learning algorithms and concepts.
 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
 Experience with machine learning and deep learning approaches to NLP is advantageous.


Summary:




Develop systems capable of interpreting and analyzing human language, requiring a deep understanding of NLP techniques and a passion for tackling linguistic and computational challenges. Responsibilities include designing NLP systems, implementing algorithms for natural language data analysis, maintaining model accuracy, and collaborating with teams to integrate NLP into various products and services.
